spans.text: AUG Para and VHS venture into the depths of the base...
You're amazing, VHS! There were so many S.F. forces in the way but all you did was go "whoosh whoosh" and you made them obey us and even fight for us~!
This must be your specialty, right? Or are all Dolls like this?
VHS~ VHS~
Would you PLEASE stop bothering me...
Aw~ But Leader put us together to look for data~
We've only just met, but if we talk more, we'll get to know each other better. Isn't that a great idea?
I'm not good at working with others.
Aw, you're shy, that's so cute~
I am NOT shy!
So you're genuinely bad at working with others?
But if I remember correctly, you volunteered to join this team, didn't you? That means there's nothing wrong with your neural cloud. But then why have you come along?
That's because...
Because?
Forget it, there's no need to talk about it.
Okay, okay, even Dolls have secrets~
AUG Para bats her eyelashes and leans in closer to VHS.
But I heard that back then, a Doll caught you unaware and...
Uh, h-hold on a minute!
I don't know how you found out, but don't say another word of it! Never bring it up again!
Ehehe~ Now I'm curious. What did that Doll do?
Since we're alone here, why don't you just tell me? It'll be our secret.
Y-You're really weird!
Hardly, humans are all like this~
Ugh... I forgot that you had a defective neural cloud...
I don't consider it a "defect"~
Instead of letting other people tell me what I am, I'd rather trust my own thoughts.
I'm just an ordinary girl who loves Dolls~ What's wrong with that?
This is because you're fitted with a malfunctioning emotion module...
You won't think this way after you're sent in for neural cloud debugging.
It's not so much that I won't think that way, but that "I" will have vanished.
You...
Is that how you see yourself?
Aw, relax, relax! No need to be so pessimistic~ You see, that's why I'm here.
No matter what kind of debugging they put me through in the future, I'm going to enjoy every day I have until then~
Let me see... This looks like the control room. Please open the door, my lovely VHS~
...Alright.
The electronic door opens after it has been hacked, and they see rows of massive glass cases filled with liquid.
These are...?
It's coolant. The servers in there are still running.
However, these are all slave machines. There ought to be a mainframe in here somewhere...
I see. Sangvis Dolls really use some incredible technology.
AUG Para walks slowly down the rows of glass containers, but when she turns around, she suddenly sees someone standing in front of her.
Ahhhh—!!!
What happened?
Er... It's nothing. I was just startled.
I doubt even a Sangvis Doll would be THAT scary... Is this also part of your "human" side?
...Ehehe, want to see?
This... O-Ouroboros?!
Scared you too, right? The last time we saw her was in our combat records, but now we can see the real deal...
She seems to be asleep, but it also looks like her eyes would open any second... She...she's so CUTE!
You can fall in love with just about anyone, can't you?
Oh yes, wasn't she reduced to an AI and locked up at Miss Persica's?
Hm. This might be a spare body, but it doesn't look dangerous...
At the same time, all the cables are connected to this place. Could this body be some kind of storage terminal?
Using a body as a storage device?
Ohhh~ No wonder we ran into so many S.F. forces. But she looks so cute, I'd want to protect her too!
...Whose side are you actually on?
I'm on the side of the cuties, ehehe~
Oh fine, I won't tease you anymore. It seems like a bit of a waste, but we can simply destroy this body, right?
No, if this body really is a storage device, then the data we're looking for ought to be in there.
So we can't wreck it? Then why don't we bring it back with us? I mean, the Commander DID ask us to bring a spare body for Ouroboros back to base.
This way, we'll be killing two birds with one stone.
Well, we'll need to confirm if it really does contain what we want...
I'm going to access it on Level II and look around.
Huh? But isn't that really dangerous?
A body used only for storage shouldn't be dangerous, and I want to try and understand it.
Oh yeah, I'll be counting on you to protect me when I'm plugged in.
What? Really?!
Ehehe~ I guarantee there won't be a single scratch on your lovely body~!
...Your reassurance isn't reassuring at all.
Poke poke~
I'm not in yet!
Ohhhh, okay, okay, nevermind then~!
(Sighs)
Connection is stable, no electronic countermeasures... Looks like it really is a storage device.
But there's no telling if Paradeus has messed with it...
Let's start by comparing it with Miss Persica's data and see what we can find.
【System - Commencing data correlation search...】
【System - ...】
【System - Search complete. Quantity exceeds displayable maximums...】
So they're Simulated Combat Logs... There are so many of them the system can't show them all?
Is this the "leftover data" that the Commander wants?
Let's just take a look at it...
【System Backend - Initializing...】
【System Backend - Connection detected, reading ID code...】
【System Backend - Target ID confirmed. Activating backup neural cloud, downloading...】
(Static)
I didn't think a "rat" would wake me up.
Hm, it's been about 10 minutes. Does it usually take Dolls this long to find a bit of data?
Oh well, I'll just check in and say hi to Leader~!
Uh~ Hello~ Can you hear me?
AUG Para, what happened? Why are you calling us all of a sudden?
Wow, it actually went through!
What are you talking about?
Eh, it's nothing~ VHS is busy now, so I wanted to see what you guys are up to.
Everyone having fun together?
You pull a stunt like this again and I'll be there in three minutes to scrap you!
Ehhh, why are you so mad at me...? Hello? Helloooo?
They hung up, huh? Well, nothing I can do about that. Time to go poke my little angel, hehehe~
Huh? Why is she so hot?!
To AUG Para's alarm, she realizes that not only is VHS's condition abnormal, S.F. forces can be heard coming from outside the control room.
At the same time, the Ouroboros body that has been serving as a "storage device" opens its eyes...
